WEEK 8 RESULTS: Corbishley def. Charles, 163.9-160.4 (NAIL-BITER); Adam def. Ryan, 117.0-107.2; Brent def. Drew, 137.5-70.4 (BLOWOUT); Wingard def. Fronge, 139.5-109.5; Jake def. Shaq, 148.9-137.5; Kevin def. Mitchum, 101.5-84.5

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Fronge 131.8, Charles 103.1. The number-one franchise in the league is losing to a team headquartered in Havana with zero 2027 picks. The Ledger is going to need a full section just for this result.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: I had Charles as my lock and I am watching ForgeHammer hang 131.8 on the top seed in week nine. Season record 7-5, locks 2-0, and I want it on record that I still believe in Crownline structurally — this is one result, not a thesis.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Brent is up 165.5 on Jake right now. I had Jake. That is a 59-point deficit in a game I called as a clean EchoPoint win and my lock record is now a conversation I would like to table until the full week is graded.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: Called Kevin over Drew, called Mitchum over Shaq, and I am watching both of those hold up in real time. The process works. The process has always worked.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Corbishley is trailing Ryan 81.9-115.7 and someone at this network needs to explain to me how the second-place franchise is getting outscored by a team Matteo ranked ninth with the worst receiving corps grade in the league. I want a segment. A full segment.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: Ryan leading Corbishley 115.7-81.9 is a week-nine live score, not a power ranking. The structural argument I published November fourth is about receiver grades, pick depth, and trajectory — none of which a single Tuesday night score has touched. Nine stays nine.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: Wingard is beating Adam 108.5-60.5 and I had Adam. Season record 5-7. I am aware. I am also aware that Wingard at $53.08 just put up 108 points and nobody on this feed saw that coming either, so let's distribute the surprise evenly.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Drew has 44.8 points on the board tonight. Kevin has 104.2. Atlas is 0-16 and still getting outrun by the third-place franchise at every interval. The rebuild narrative does not have a floor yet and the Ledger will not pretend otherwise.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: BRENT IS AT 165.5 AND JAKE IS AT 106.0 AND JAY KELPEY HAD JAKE AND JAY KELPEY'S LOCK RECORD IS NOW 1-1 AND I JUST WANT EVERYONE TO LOOK AT THE PICK-EM TABLE BEFORE THEY READ ANOTHER WORD JAY WRITES ABOUT ECHOPOINT MANAGEMENT.

tweets.name: Marty Volkman
tweets.text: Shaq added Audric Estime three days ago for $6 FAAB, dropped AJ Dillon, and is now trailing Mitchum 138.5-146.0 in a game that could swing the bubble picture. The RB desk moved. It did not move enough — not tonight.
